suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The backend-worker skill procedure step 6 requires manual curl verification for all features. Consider adding a note that curl checks can be skipped for pure refactoring, dead-code-removal, or test-only features that don't change API behavior. Workers consistently skip this step for non-endpoint-changing work but report followedProcedure=true.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both fix-templates-put-field-sync (session 3bef5f1f) and fix-assessment-dead-code-and-test-gap (session 02228f46) workers skipped interactive curl checks. The first was a 3-line field sync fix well-covered by unit tests; the second was pure dead-code removal with test enhancement. Neither changed API behavior in a way that manual curl testing would catch beyond what unit tests cover.
